title: Rafael and the Border
author: Astrid Hartwell
blurb: Lena Brightwater, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
